posts.author: Dju
posts.body:
Hello everyone,
I’m looking for a
Ruin-Stone Golem
for my RPG Maker MV project.
More specifically, I need a
complete set
, including:
Character sprite (overworld)
Animated SV battler
Face graphic
for dialogue
The creature is meant to be encountered deep inside ancient ruins hidden in a forest, so I’m looking for a golem made of
weathered ruin stones
, moss, cracks, and an overall ancient vibe.
If anyone knows an existing resource (free or paid), or if someone would be willing to create one, I’d greatly appreciate it.
Thank you in advance for your help!
Have a great day!
